newsitem.title: USA: Revco signs confidentiality pact with Big B.
newsitem.headline: Revco signs confidentiality pact with Big B.

text.p: Revco D.S. Inc said that it has signed a confidentiality pact with Big B Inc as part of its effort to buy the regional drugstore chain.
As part of the agreement, Revco said it will not start a proxy solicitiation or take any other actions to gain control of Big B, other than its tender offer, until November 30.

Revco also said it has extended its tender offer for Big B, which had been set to expire on October 7, until October 18. Revco said that as of October 3, 53,300 shares of Big B stock had been tendered to Revco under its offer.
Revco launched a cash tender offer of $15 per share for Big B on September 9. Big B rejected the $332 million offer as financially inadequate.

Since then, the two companies have been haggling over terms of a confidentiality agreement, which would enable Revco to analyze confidential financial information. In the meantime, Big B has signed confidentiality pacts with other potential bidders and indicated that they are willing to pay more than $15 per share.

"We expect that the confidentiality agreement with Big B will allow us to work on a level playing field toward our goal of negotiating a transaction that is enthusiastically supported by Big B's shareholders and employees, as well as Big B's many loyal customers," Revco chief executive officer Dwayne Hoven said in a news release.
The confidentiality agreement also calls a temoporary halt to federal litigation filed by both companies over Big B's poison pill antitakeover plan.
